svg.title: siftwise select on RDFLib/rdflib
svg.desc: A terminal running siftwise select on an rdflib commit that changed rdflib/graph.py and test/test_dataset/test_dataset.py. The Python import graph finds 325 test files that import changed modules, siftwise selects 17921 of 18020 known tests, and prints a pytest command.
